critical_code_review_comments: Forgot password flow correctly does not leak whether email exists
Reset tokens are properly invalidated after use (delete_many on email)
Token expiry check (1 hour) is implemented correctly
Worker invite flow creates user in both business_users and users collections
InviteSetupPage.js correctly handles all states: loading, error, setup form, success
ResetPasswordPage.js correctly hides token input when token is in URL
seed_data_creation: Test worker frontendtestworker@churvox.com was created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 18 verified all forgot-password and worker-invite flows. Key findings: (1) Forgot password creates token in password_reset_tokens collection, (2) Reset password invalidates all tokens for that email after use, (3) Token expiry is 1 hour, (4) Worker invite uses business_users._id as the invite token, (5) Accepting invite creates user in users collection with role=worker, (6) Resend API key is INVALID (error 1010) so emails don't actually send - this is expected and handled gracefully. All frontend pages have proper data-testid attributes for testing.

mocked_apis.note: Resend email API returns 403 (invalid key) but all code handles this gracefully - emails won't send but flows complete successfully
